blurb:
• This is a private, shopping tour for your group only. 

It's a fun day for the young shopper who is on a budget and enjoys the thrill of the hunt.

Get ready to second-hand shop your way through the city at the best shops for fun and inexpensive clothing!

Young shoppers prefer current trends worn by their peers; renew their wardrobe far more frequently than adults do; are less fussy about fabric content; spends far less on a garment than an adult would.

Enjoy 2.5 to 3 hours of guided shopping in New York City like a true New Yorker who will select pieces she thinks you may enjoy. We’ll walk approximately 1.5 miles, visit up to 4 second-hand stores, and spend 20 min at each location.

 • Your booking is private and personalized, closed to your group only.

 • Hassle-free meet-up location in Manhattan.

 • Enjoy your guide's personal shopping attention with time to try-on clothing.
